summary: Vicore Pharma Holding AB furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited Q3 2026 interim report and press release, a routine quarterly earnings disclosure rather than a special situation. The filing notes the July 2026 US dual listing of American Depositary Shares on Nasdaq Capital Market under VCRE alongside the Nasdaq Stockholm VICO listing, plus the appointment of Rob Slack as Chief Scientific Officer after the period. The independent Data Monitoring Committee recommended the Phase 2b ASPIRE trial continue after a pre-planned futility analysis, with topline data expected mid-2027. No deal terms, stake, price, premium or board recommendation apply.
